title: Reformat 96 Well Plates to 384 Well Plate for qPCR
author: Opentrons
materials: Reformat up to four 96 well plates into a 384 well PCR plate for downstream qPCR. This protocol will also add mastermix to the necessary wells and then transfer patient samples to the corresponding wells. --- * [Opentrons 20uL Tips](https://shop.opentrons.com/collections/opentrons-tips/products/opentrons-10ul-tips) * [Opentrons 20uL Filter Tips](https://shop.opentrons.com/collections/opentrons-tips/products/opentrons-20ul-filter-tips) * [KingFisher 96 Deep Well Plate 2mL](https://www.thermofisher.com/order/catalog/product/95040450#/95040450) * [MicroAmp™ Optical 384-Well Reaction Plate with Barcode](https://www.thermofisher.com/order/catalog/product/4309849?SID=srch-srp-4309849#/4309849?SID=srch-srp-4309849) * [Opentrons 24 Tube Rack with Eppendorf 1.5 mL Safe-Lock Snapcap](https://shop.opentrons.com/products/tube-rack-set-1?_ga=2.232823964.387689945.1619373905-1181961818.1604785212&_gl=1%2Akkqpyx%2A_ga%2AMTE4MTk2MTgxOC4xNjA0Nzg1MjEy%2A_ga_GNSMNLW4RY%2AMTYxOTQ1ODk2Mi4xOTguMS4xNjE5NDU5NTQzLjA.) * [P20 Single Channel GEN2](https://shop.opentrons.com/collections/ot-2-robot/products/single-channel-electronic-pipette?variant=31059478970462) For more detailed information on compatible labware, please visit our [Labware Library](https://labware.opentrons.com/). --- **Deck Setup** **Note**: A full run with 4 plates with a master mix transfer volume of 10 uL will require 3,760 uL of master mix. This is divided into 3 tubes in the picture above. There is a parameter below that asks for the `Master Mix Volume per Tube`. By default this is set to 1400 uL (**Recommendation: Always add more than 1400 uL to prevent aspirating air**) in order to account for dead volume. You can adjust this as needed and the protocol will automatically determine how many tubes it needs. **For Example**: If the `Master Mix Volume per Tube` is set to 1000 uL the protocol will determine 4 tubes are needed (A1, B1, C1, D1) with at least 1000 uL in each tube for a run with four full plates. steps.title: Gather required labware and consumables
steps.instruction: Collect the following items: Opentrons 20 µL tips, Opentrons 20 µL filter tips, KingFisher 96 deep‑well plate (2 mL), MicroAmp™ Optical 384‑well reaction plate with barcode, Opentrons 24‑tube rack with Eppendorf 1.5 mL safe‑lock snap‑cap tubes, and a P20 single‑channel GEN2 pipette.

steps.title: Determine master‑mix volume per tube
steps.instruction: For a full run with four 96‑well plates and a master‑mix transfer volume of 10 µL per well, you will need 3 760 µL of master mix. By default the protocol sets the ‘Master Mix Volume per Tube’ to 1 400 µL (add more than 1 400 µL to avoid aspirating air). Adjust this value as needed; the protocol will automatically calculate how many tubes are required. Example: setting the volume to 1 000 µL results in four tubes (A1, B1, C1, D1) each containing at least 1 000 µL.

steps.title: Enter protocol parameters
steps.instruction: In the Opentrons app, input your protocol parameters, including the chosen ‘Master Mix Volume per Tube’ and any other required settings.

steps.title: Download and unzip protocol files
steps.instruction: Download the protocol package from the provided source and unzip it if necessary.

steps.title: Upload custom labware definitions
steps.instruction: If you are using custom labware, navigate to **More > Custom Labware > Add Labware** in the OT App and upload the corresponding .json files.

steps.title: Upload the protocol script
steps.instruction: In the OT App’s **Protocol** tab, upload the protocol file with a .py extension.

steps.title: Arrange deck according to map
steps.instruction: Place the labware on the robot deck exactly as shown in the deck map (e.g., tip racks, plates, tube rack, etc.).

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipette
steps.instruction: Using the OT App, calibrate each piece of labware, the tip rack, and the P20 pipette. Use calibration tips as described in the support articles.

steps.title: Execute the protocol
steps.instruction: Press **Run** in the OT App to start the automated reformatting of up to four 96‑well plates into the 384‑well plate, including master‑mix dispensing and sample transfer.
